title: Great idea, but too small and too flimsy!
text: Great idea, but too small and too flimsy!. Had older, sturdier, larger model that lasted about 20 years. It's lid was non-removable and had sturdier attachment. this one only uses 3 gallon bags, is unsteady, and its lid comes off every time I open it. Wish the older model was still available. This won't last very long.

product_metadata.title: Extrufix 15301 Original Kitchen Rack 3 Gallon, White (1, 3 Gallon)
features: OFF THE FLOOR: Our compact modern design means you can mount the Original Kitchen Rack to the under-sink cupboard and other small spaces. No more garbage bins on the floor taking up valuable space.
MORE SAFETY: Keeps kitchen waste away from pets and children. Ensure a safe kitchen and keep pets out of trouble.

DESIGNED FOR LEAK-PROOF BAGS: This kitchen rack is designed to fit tightly and securely with our Original Kitchen Rack Bags. Strong, thick plastic bags ensure no leaks or tears with regular kitchen waste. Integrates bag roll holder keeps your next bag at your fingertips.
LESS MESS: The Original Kitchen Rack is easy to keep clean. The minimal surfaces are coated with a durable poly that can be quickly wiped off. No bins to wash-out.
